name: agents
description: Portable model calling reference: local entry table plus llm-call and tool-call clients; machine inventory is a local overlay.

interface.shortDescription: Portable model calling reference and clients
interface.longDescription: Look up a model name in a machine-local entry table, call LLM APIs and gateway tools through the portable clients, and report gaps without silent fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use the agents calling reference to find the entry for this model name and route.
Run the batch through the recommended client and report the model that actually answered.
